question: Is OpenAI's upcoming "Astra" model going to be called GPT-6?
resolution_criteria:
OpenAI is reportedly not sure between calling it GPT-6 and GPT-5.7

To be clear, "GPT-6 Astra" as a name would meet the YES requirement
research:
## Astra naming (GPT-6 vs GPT-5.7): research as of 2026-08-25

I didn't find an official name for Astra published on or before 2026-08-25. As of the cutoff the name was still unannounced. Every page I tried to open directly was blocked by the proxy, so the details below come from search-result summaries and could not be checked against the full articles.

### 1. Resolution source
- No specific URL is given in the criteria. In practice the question will be settled by OpenAI's own announcement or launch post (openai.com, the developer docs or the API model string) giving Astra's official name. "GPT-6 Astra" would count as YES.
- 2026-08-25: I found no official OpenAI naming announcement on or before this date. OpenAI's public references so far call it "Astra" and "our next major model."

### 2. Current status
- Not settled. Up to the cutoff, reporting describes the name as undecided between GPT-6, GPT-5.7 or a separate tier next to Sol, Terra and Luna.
- 2026-07-31 (reported): The Information said OpenAI had not decided whether the model would be GPT-6, GPT-5.7 or something else. I couldn't reach The Information's article; this comes from secondary summaries. [howtouseastra.com](https://howtouseastra.com/is-astra-gpt-6/)

### 3. Recent news (newest first)
- About 2026-08-21: A Manifold market priced a 73% chance of "something big in AI this week," which suggests people expected the release soon. [tech-insider](https://tech-insider.org/manifold-ai-something-happens-week-aug-21-2026/)
- 2026-08-07: A report citing an insider said OpenAI planned to launch its next flagship, codenamed Astra, "next week." The launch did not happen within that window. [kucoin](https://kucoin.com/news/flash/openai-developing-new-ai-model-astra-for-long-term-tasks)
- July-August 2026: Some commentators thought GPT-5.7 was the most likely name and that "Astra" was only an internal provisional name. [36kr](https://eu.36kr.com/en/p/3928686064171400)
- 2026-08-01: OpenAI published a math post saying an internal version of Astra, "our next major model," solved ten previously open problems. The post did not give a product name. [The Decoder](https://the-decoder.com/openai-announces-its-next-major-model-astra-by-dropping-ten-previously-unsolved-math-solutions/), [Gizmodo](https://gizmodo.com/openai-smuggled-the-announcement-of-astra-its-next-ai-model-into-a-blog-post-about-math-2000793689)
- July 2026 (reported): The release was held back for safety work after a July incident. One secondary source says Astra was paused internally over its ability to find zero-day exploits. This is relevant to when it launches, not what it's called.
- Background: the current lineup is the GPT-5.6 family (Sol, Terra, Luna), which got API price cuts on 2026-07-30. If OpenAI kept incrementing as usual, the next name would be "5.7." [datanorth](https://datanorth.ai/news/openai-releases-gpt-5-6-sol-terra-and-luna), [APIYI](https://docs.apiyi.com/en/live/2026-07/gpt-5-6-terra-luna-price-cut)

### 4. Base rates
- OpenAI has used both kinds of name for big new models. Some got whole-number jumps (GPT-4 in 2023, GPT-5 in August 2025). Others got decimal versions inside the GPT-5 era (5.1 through 5.6, roughly every 1 to 3 months). [Wikipedia GPT-5](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/GPT-5), [GPT-5.4](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/GPT-5.4)
- GPT-4.5 is an example of a large model that got a decimal name rather than the next whole number. [Wikipedia GPT-4.5](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/GPT-4.5)
- Calling Astra "our next major model" and leading with a showcase of frontier capability fits the pattern OpenAI has used before for a generational jump, but it doesn't decide the name.

### 5. Other forecasts
- Manifold has markets with this exact wording (same description: "reportedly not sure between GPT-6 and GPT-5.7"). Snapshots I found put it at about 31% to 42%, but I couldn't confirm the dates of those snapshots or the price on 2026-08-25. One commenter argued the market was underpricing a standalone "Astra" name. [Manifold (Bayesian)](https://manifold.markets/Bayesian/is-openais-upcoming-astra-model-goi), [Manifold (BenjaminShindel)](https://manifold.markets/BenjaminShindel/is-openais-upcoming-astra-model-goi)
- 2026-08-07: Polymarket put Astra's release by August 31 at 78%. A separate Polymarket contract on a "GPT-6" release in the same window was at 21%. That gap suggests traders didn't assume Astra would be branded GPT-6. [pasqualepillitteri.it](https://pasqualepillitteri.it/en/news/10089/polymarket-astra-78-percent-august)
- Manifold release-date market (date not confirmed): Aug 17-30 at 31%, Aug 31-Sep 13 at 43%. [Manifold](https://manifold.markets/prismatic/openais-astra-released-between)

### 6. Upcoming events before resolution (about 2026-09-05)
- An Astra launch or limited preview: release-date markets put the most weight on late August to mid-September. Any launch post, system card or API model ID would settle the name.
- Possible leaks: model strings in the API, ChatGPT, or OpenRouter or other model catalogs, plus any new report from The Information.
- Safety gating: if the release slips past about 2026-09-05, the name could stay unannounced by the resolution date.

Sources: [howtouseastra](https://howtouseastra.com/is-astra-gpt-6/), [The Decoder](https://the-decoder.com/openai-announces-its-next-major-model-astra-by-dropping-ten-previously-unsolved-math-solutions/), [Gizmodo](https://gizmodo.com/openai-smuggled-the-announcement-of-astra-its-next-ai-model-into-a-blog-post-about-math-2000793689), [kucoin](https://kucoin.com/news/flash/openai-developing-new-ai-model-astra-for-long-term-tasks), [36kr](https://eu.36kr.com/en/p/3928686064171400), [datanorth](https://datanorth.ai/news/openai-releases-gpt-5-6-sol-terra-and-luna), [APIYI](https://docs.apiyi.com/en/live/2026-07/gpt-5-6-terra-luna-price-cut), [tech-insider](https://tech-insider.org/manifold-ai-something-happens-week-aug-21-2026/), [pasqualepillitteri.it](https://pasqualepillitteri.it/en/news/10089/polymarket-astra-78-percent-august), [Manifold 1](https://manifold.markets/Bayesian/is-openais-upcoming-astra-model-goi), [Manifold 2](https://manifold.markets/BenjaminShindel/is-openais-upcoming-astra-model-goi), [Manifold 3](https://manifold.markets/prismatic/openais-astra-released-between), [Wikipedia GPT-5](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/GPT-5), [GPT-4.5](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/GPT-4.5), [GPT-5.4](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/GPT-5.4)
